programmes.d: Rayna is upset when her record company asks her to tour as the opening act for a popular newcomer; Rayna's father, Lamar, disregards her wishes when he backs her husband in a run for mayor of Nashville.

As Teddy's campaign progresses, Rayna must endure an investigation that reveals family secrets; Juliette sees Deacon perform with Rayna; Scarlett is torn between her dream and her commitment to Avery.
George and Zoe play Romeo and Juliet. Lemon and Wade are excited about taking over the reins at the Rammer Jammer, but things come to a halt when they lose all the staff.
Zoe tricks Jonah (Travis Van Winkle) into spilling a secret about Brick. Wade and Lemon each try to prove they know what is best for the new Rammer Jammer.
Rose (Mckaley Miller) and Max (Nicholas Podany) play matchmaker for Zoe. Rob Huebel (Childrens Hospital) guest stars as a potential love interest.
In the season finale, Zoe decides to visit New York, but a medical emergency on the plane forces her to complete the trip with an unexpected companion. The band Gloriana performs.
In the season premiere, after a summer in New York, Zoe is ready to move permanently, but first she must return to BlueBell. Lemon has a plan to help out Wade in front of Zoe.
Lavon and AnnaBeth invite Zoe and Joel (Josh Cooke) over for a quiet dinner, but when Lemon invites herself and Alabama's most eligible bachelor (Ryan Mcpartlin), things go awry.
Lemon finds herself in hot water. George finds himself needing medical attention during a tutoring session with Lynly (Antoinette Robertson), forcing him to call Zoe for help.
Lemon is blacklisted from the Junior League Halloween Masquerade party, but her Grandma Bettie (Maree Cheatham) helps out. Lavon has a surprise for his anniversary with AnnaBeth.
Zoe tries to fix the town's perception of Joel (Josh Cooke). Lavon begs Lemon for help with the Gazebos of Alabama calendar. George and Lynly (Antoinette Robertson) work together.
Lemon receives an offer she may not be able to refuse. AnnaBeth seems eager for Lavon to go out of town, causing him to wonder why. Plus, is Zoe ready to face her extended family?
Zoe is leery of how much Joel (Josh Cooke) and Wade hang out. Lavon uses the excuse of coaching his track team to avoid talking to AnnaBeth. Antoinette Robertson appears as Lynly.
Zoe hosts a Hanukkah party. Lemon enlists George and Lynly (Antoinette Robertson) to help uncover information about one of Brick's exes. Danielle Bradbery performs.
Lavon enlists George to help save BlueBell from merging with another town. To help keep the planned merger quiet, Zoe uses Joel (Josh Cooke) and AnnaBeth to create a distraction.
When Brick is asked to help with the local cabaret, he nominates Zoe. Lynly's (Antoinette Robertson) jealousy of George's close friendship with Tansy (Mircea Monroe) continues.
Lavon enlists the entire town's help to try and have BlueBell named a historic town. Wade takes a big step in his relationship by meeting Vivian's (Lauren Bittner) son.
Brick agrees to help Zoe fix up the house she and Joel (JOSH COOKE) bought, but only if she can get the townspeople to lose 500 pounds collectively for Health and Wellness Month.
